title: The Tower of Living and Dying
author: Spark, Anna Smith

highlights.text: Maggots on a corpse, thought Tobias. That’s what people are. Maggots on a corpse. Life really is a pile of shit. Life’s shit and unfair and pointless and hurts.
Life’s a pile of shit. Life’s unfair and pointless and hurts. Life’s a long slow painful way of dying. But I don’t, I don’t want to die. I don’t want to die.
